name: ConstrainedBox
description: A widget that imposes additional constraints on its child. Useful for limiting or forcing a child widget’s size.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: The additional constraints to apply to the child widget.
properties.possible_values: BoxConstraints.tight(Size), BoxConstraints(minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight), etc.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the constrained box.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
